title: Easy Chicken Rice Casserole
description: A mild dish of rice with chicken and cream of chicken soup. Simple, comforting food.
ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into bite size pieces
2 (10.75 ounce) cans condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a medium bowl combine the milk, rice, soup and seasoned salt if desired. Mix well. Pour mixture into a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Add the chicken pieces.

Cover dish tightly with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for approximately 90 minutes or until rice is done, stirring every 30 minutes. Uncover the dish and bake for another 15 minutes to allow the rice to brown.

video.description: In this video, learn how to make easy chicken rice casserole, a simple and creamy dish perfect for a weeknight meal. This video will show you how to combine chicken pieces, rice, milk, cream of chicken soup, and seasoned salt for a comforting and flavorful casserole. This easy casserole is a family-friendly dish that's both budget-friendly and delicious.
